profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | .NET MAUI • C# • Semiconductor • Cross‑Platform Mobile/Desktop
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 13+ years of experience across mobile and desktop systems. Specializes in modular architecture, cross-platform UI frameworks (.NET MAUI, Xamarin), and velocity-focused engineering practices. Provides technical leadership through system design, DevOps enablement, and cross-functional collaboration.

positions.title: Senior C++ Engineer
positions.description:
• SME for Zeta-series optical profilers (Zeta-20/300/388), used for 3D wafer imaging and analysis.
• Led Zeta3D software support: hardware qualification, code-level investigations, and L4 escalations.
• Enhanced surface metrology and automation; integrated SEMI standards (E30, E84, E87).
• Modernized toolchain: migrated to C++14, VS2022, and enabled C++/CLI interop with WPF/.NET.
• Built an analysis server to extend the legacy feature set in Zeta3D.
• Built an MSBuild-driven NuGet toolchain for C++ that packaged native DLLs, headers, and libs into reusable CI/CD-ready components.
• Led Git migration and improved build/release workflows as part of broader DevOps modernization.
• Placed 4th in the 2025 Hackathon (ASP.NET Blazor self-service portal).
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Windows · Google Test · Software Architecture · Microsoft Foundation Class (MFC) · Optical Metrology · SECS/GEM · Dependency Injection · gRPC · C++/CLI · TCP/IP

positions.title: Senior Xamarin Engineer
positions.locationName: Sterling Heights, Michigan, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Developed features for the OneControl smart RV mobile app using Xamarin, iOS, and Android.
• Key player in implementing the new look of our app.
• Resolved critical threading issues with the flagship feature of one of our major releases.
• Promoted to the core UI group to author custom layouts and widgets for use by other team members.
• Mentored other developers, encouraging best practices (e.g. SOLID and quality PR reviews).
• Created backend processes to communicate with BLE devices and wrote reactive UI to display real-time data
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Git · Bluetooth Low Energy · Xamarin · Software Architecture · .NET · Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM) · 2D graphics · iOS Development · Code Review · Dependency Injection · Mentoring · Android SDK

positions.title: Android Engineer & Consultant
positions.description:
• Delivered features for the FordPass & Lincoln Way mobile apps to support Ford’s EV programs, using 
technologies such as Kotlin, RxJava, OkHttp, Dagger2, Gradle, and Mockito/MockK.
• Modularized app architecture, reducing build time by 7x and enabling TDD in my team.
• Led in pair-programming sessions by promoting software professionalism, Clean Architecture, and 
MVVM.
• Helped transition to AndroidX by incorporating Jetpack Navigation libraries.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Test Driven Development · Software Architecture · Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM) · Code Review · Kotlin · Dependency Injection · Mentoring · REST APIs · Android SDK · Dagger2 · Gradle · ReactiveX

positions.title: Software Engineer & Founder
positions.description: This is my own software consultancy, created to diversify my skillset and establish a corporate presence.

positions.title: Controls Engineer
positions.description:
• Upgraded codebase from WinForms to a multi-layered and modular WPF-based architecture.
• Designed, developed, tested, and deployed an HMI capable of recording months’ worth of real-time 
NVH data without memory leaks.
• Introduced a CI/CD server, a branching and releasing strategy, and a private NuGet feed.
• Traveled to customer sites to service and close multiple projects.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · WPF · Peer-to-peer Computing · Windows · Software Architecture · Subversion · .NET · Software Project Management · DevOps · PLC Allen Bradley · TeamCity · Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM) · Code Review · Dependency Injection · Mentoring · Prism · Clean Architecture · SOLID Design Principles

positions.title: Software Engineering Co-Op
positions.description:
• Built vehicle simulators using WinForms & WPF to test automotive infotainment and HVAC controllers, communicating over LIN, CAN, and I2C.
• Created a software tool that would extract port configuration information from Intel HEX binaries to aid our validation process.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · LIN · WPF · CAN · Windows · Software Architecture · I2C · .NET · Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM) · WinForms · Vehicle Spy

positions.title: CAD Applications Co-Op
positions.locationName: Wixom, MI and Auburn Hills, MI · On-site
positions.description: Develop applications that interface with AutoCAD and SolidWorks to automate documentation processes.

projects.title: Blask the Box
projects.description: This is a desktop port of an arcade-style game I made, using a newer tech stack and ECS-based game architecture.
